regime: IVA tasa 0% por exportación de servicios

source.title: Ley del Impuesto al Valor Agregado, art. 29 (Orden Jurídico Nacional, texto vigente, última reforma DOF 12-11-2021); Reglamento de la LIVA, arts. 58 y 61 (https://www.gob.mx/cms/uploads/attachment/file/136558/reg_ley_isr_iva.pdf)

params.benefit: 0% VAT on services exported by a Mexican resident (LIVA art. 29)
params.note: Reglamento art. 58 is a deeming rule ("entre otros supuestos"), so another way to prove the service is used abroad may exist; collecting in USDC leaves the safe harbour rather than proving the 0% rate is lost. The LIVA text is the 2021 consolidated version and the Reglamento is the 2006 original; later reforms and SAT general rules were not checked.

conditions.description: A service sold to a foreign client is treated as used abroad, and so taxed at 0%, when the foreign client without an establishment in Mexico contracts and pays it by named check or funds transfer into the provider's account at a Mexican credit institution or brokerage, and the money comes from an account at a foreign financial institution. A stablecoin transfer is neither.
conditions.basis: Reglamento de la LIVA art. 58, second paragraph: "siempre que se paguen mediante cheque nominativo o transferencia de fondos a las cuentas del prestador del servicio en instituciones de crédito o casas de bolsa y el pago provenga de cuentas de instituciones financieras ubicadas en el extranjero"; art. 61 applies it to independent personal services; LIVA art. 29, last paragraph.

conditions.description: For IT services (application development and maintenance, data processing and storage, hosting, information security), the payment must be made electronically from a foreign financial institution's account into the provider's account at a credit institution in Mexico.
conditions.basis: LIVA art. 29, fracción IV, inciso i), requirement 4: "Que el pago se realice a través de medios electrónicos y provenga de cuentas de instituciones financieras ubicadas en el extranjero, mismo que deberá realizarse a una cuenta del prestador del servicio en instituciones de crédito en México."
